$comment: Binds each CLOSED codelist to the schema location whose enum it governs. The CSV is the single record; the enum is generated from it. Where two records of one relationship exist, keep one and generate the other. See docs/state-model.md §11.

closed.note: Property is `documentType`, not `type`. The earlier pointer did not resolve and --write silently skipped it, leaving the property unenforced — which is why an unresolved pointer is a hard failure rather than a warning.
No single property binds it; Event.eventType admits open values too. Enforced by check-codelists.js, not by enum injection.

open.note: Extension space. Values may be added by PR.
Auction extension; enum already present in schema.

retired.decision: Deleted. Submission.status carries the vocabulary inline, as every other lifecycle-bearing object does; the CSV was referenced by no schema and marked closed nowhere. Keeping both would be the second hand-maintained record that docs/state-model.md §11 defines as a defect.
